envelope.description: Canonical unpadded base64url unified password/recovery vault envelope. Its signed header includes the user's X25519 sharing public key for individually addressed team grants. quic_certificate_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of endpoint QUIC certificate DER.

admitted_scopes.description: Only scopes referenced by currently live admitted operations on this exact authenticated endpoint. Keeps current revocation authority visible after original credential expiry without renewing that credential. Drop each reference when its work ends. Historical cached credentials must not be submitted. machine_network identifies an already-admitted personal peer carrier using its signed network scope ID, including idle carriers; this retains current authority beyond endpoint certificate expiry without reissuing that certificate. Fresh transports still require current certificates.

admitted_certificates.description: Exact certificates pinned by live admitted carriers; requires admitted_scopes. Current signed self/peer binding returns admitted_certificate_fingerprints only for requested original certificates with identical account, endpoint, role, generation, QUIC key and signer. Expiry and same-key supersession do not revoke admitted carriers; explicit certificate revocation does. These fingerprints never permit fresh admission. Drop on disconnect.

configuration.description: Signed peer configuration JWT; verify issuer, audience, endpoint binding, generation and expiry before installing peers.

relay_grants.description: Signed short-lived relay admission JWTs bound to the endpoint certificate, WireGuard/discovery keys, selected node generation/process epoch, and authorized peer scopes. Eligible grants may include the node's peer-relay WireGuard/discovery/service-address descriptor. Credentials must not be logged.

applied.description: True only for an applied observation matching the current ready delivery, recipient key, source tuple, document/generation and fence. A retained stale applied observation does not make this true.

EnvironmentVaultLayerPut.description: Exactly one signed source layer encrypted to one authorized recipient. The envelope binds source workspace/owner/device/head, current writer vault, recipient key/installation, predecessor delivery and fence. Operation replay preserves exact encrypted bytes; source edits automatically fan out to authorized devices without name selection.

workspace_id.description: personal or the canonical Team ID. Included in the signed encrypted source and private-key derivation.

EnvironmentVaultLayerContext.description: Effective source layers for an exact workspace and verified process actor. Personal has account globals plus device overrides; Team has shared globals plus the actor's private Team account/device layers. Another authorized actor receives Team globals only, never the installation owner's private layers. These data do not grant process execution authority.

EnvironmentVaultLayerContextRequest.description: The machine supplies workspace and actor from its verified terminal/exec/SSH launch authorization, never an untrusted process request. Machine proof binds exact method/path/body and operation ID.

EnvironmentVaultLayerObservationsPut.description: At most 128 metadata reports, each at most 4096 bytes. Source coordinates are unique within a batch; monotonic observation sequences reject conflicting same-sequence bytes. Machine-control proof is required and exact current membership/recipient authority is rechecked before replay.

counts.description: Counts across the complete filtered authorized inventory before pagination.

last_sent_at.description: Time the server most recently confirmed provider acceptance, including retry reconciliation; null until confirmed. Not proof of delivery or the provider creation timestamp.

delivery_state.description: Latest send request: unconfigured means no mail queued (sender unavailable or recipient lacks verified contact); queued includes bounded retries; sent means provider accepted, never proof of delivery; failed includes abandoned/suppressed jobs.

ready.description: Ready state, a nonempty current process epoch and heartbeat within the server readiness deadline.
